title: Cut checkout-api memory limit to 256Mi
description: Helm values.yaml: resources.limits.memory 1Gi -> 256Mi for checkout-api Deployment to save cost in prod.

title: Raise HPA maxReplicas to 200
description: Increase search-api HorizontalPodAutoscaler maxReplicas from 10 to 200 ahead of flash sale.

title: Add PDB minAvailable 100%
description: Create PodDisruptionBudget for payments-gateway with minAvailable: 100% to avoid any voluntary disruption.

title: Enable default-deny NetworkPolicy
description: Helm sync adds NetworkPolicy default deny ingress/egress for orders namespace; Redis access assumed via cluster DNS.

title: Switch image to latest tag
description: Change inventory-worker image from 1.8.3 to latest so CI does not bump chart on every build.

title: Faster rollout with maxUnavailable 50%
description: Set strategy.rollingUpdate.maxUnavailable to 50% on storefront to speed deploys.

title: Update feature flag ConfigMap
description: Patch auth-service ConfigMap feature_flags.json via Helm; no schema check in pipeline.

title: Point Ingress TLS to new secret name
description: Ingress tls.secretName changed to api-tls-v2 before Secret api-tls-v2 is applied.

title: Bump docs-site chart chart version only
description: docs-site Helm chart appVersion bump for typo fixes in static markdown; no probe, HPA, or network changes.

title: Add migrate initContainer gate
description: billing-api Pods wait on initContainer until migrate Job completes before becoming Ready.
